purpose: Concept review only; no Godot or Blender scene edits. Plan silhouettes are approximate, not engineering dimensions.
initial_prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver ONE landscape 16:9 image, game environment concept that looks like a high quality real-time 3D action roguelite gameplay screenshot. Realistic PBR materials, natural physically plausible sunlight and shadow, fairy-tale forest atmosphere. NOT cartoon, NOT low poly, NOT toy diorama, NOT stage lighting, NOT cinematic eye-level landscape. Perspective camera elevated with 33 degree downward pitch, 38 degree vertical FOV, pulled back to show the ENTIRE arena including near boundary. Ground occupies most of image, no sky or horizon. Hades/Diablo-like readable overhead gameplay composition but natural realistic materials. One small 1.7 meter adult human swordsman standing at arena center as scale cue, normal proportions, sword at side, no combat effects. Arena ~22m wide x20m deep, level open traversable ground, at least 75% of center uncluttered; just 3 knee-high tactical obstacles off center, broad clear movement lanes. Tall trees/rocks allowed ONLY at far/top and lateral boundary; bottom foreground low moss, stones and grasses only, never foliage obscuring arena. Natural subtle contact shadows, no theatrical spotlights. Restrained detail on ground, no large red or pink ground patches: red combat telegraphs must remain readable. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, health bars, borders, watermark. Full-bleed single view, NOT montage. Scene 1 CHERRY BLOSSOM CREEK VALLEY. Sunny morning. Entire broad combat clearing encircled by lush forest and a few mature pink-flowered cherry trees at back and sides. A very shallow transparent ankle-deep creek, 2-3m wide, flows diagonally from upper left through the clearing to lower right; visibly continuous level pebble bed and gently sloped banks, every part fordable, NO bridge, NO deep ravine. Several flat low stepping stones in creek. Mossy wet dark boulders only along edges. At rear-left a small 2-3m waterfall on mossy rock wall feeds the creek. Central ground mostly short green grass and patches of damp neutral brown earth, sparse scattered petals and tiny wildflowers confined mostly to edges. Three knee-high combat obstacles: a flat rock left-middle, stump right-middle, flat rock lower-left, far apart. Two clear outgoing paths at back: one upper-center between trees and one upper-right beside mossy rocks. Dappled morning sun, tiny hint of water mist by falls, lively clear natural color, realistic translucency of foliage. Composition should feel like a spacious playable level, not a narrow river corridor.

gameplay_refinements.prompt: Edit this image precisely, preserve all composition, realistic materials, lighting, camera, 16:9 framing, huge background trees, root arch exits, character, forest floor, and obstacle positions. Change ONLY the three obstacles INSIDE the clearing: reduce their height so tallest point is at the small center human's knee (about 0.5 meters). Especially cut the large left-middle stump down to a short flat stump; shrink right-middle boulder's height, flatten lower-left fallen root. Keep their footprint and natural moss. These are low dodge cover, no player occlusion. Do NOT reduce the height of trees/roots at boundary. No text or UI.

Edit this image precisely, preserve the whole composition, perspective camera, realistic material and sunlight, sacred tree, altar, circular floor, ring water, character, exits. Change ONLY the tall columns at LOWER foreground left and right: make every foreground column a LOW knee-height broken stone base (0.5 meters), so no tall vertical object exists along bottom third of image. Keep tall columns at TOP/background and upper sides. Also keep the three drums ON the platform below character knee height, lowering only their height if necessary. Preserve 16:9, no text or UI.

layout_prompts: Create ONE pure TWO-DIMENSIONAL LANDSCAPE ARCHITECTURAL SITE PLAN SKETCH, 16:9 sheet. Exact vertical zenith view, XY plane, absolutely ZERO perspective or elevation. Colored ink and light watercolor flat diagram on cream paper. Like a professional landscape architect's flat planting plan, NOT isometric, NOT an illustration viewed obliquely, NOT a landscape painting. Do not show ANY sides of trunks, walls, rocks, columns, human bodies or arches. ONLY footprints, top outlines, contours, flat color fills. Paths remain parallel, tree trunks drawn as circular cross-sections, obstacles drawn flat filled silhouettes, not 3D objects. Layout roughly square centered with paper margins on left and right, full site visible, not stretched wide. Use pale sage/ochre for open walkable area, outlined dark gray/brown for obstacles, blue for water where present, gold arrows for exits. NO text, letters, words, numbers, legend, compass labels, UI, ruler or dimension labels. Minimal crisp design sketch; no heavy shadows. An almost square 22x20m moss/earth clearing. A pale blue 2.5m wide shallow fordable stream enters from northwest, curves across upper-center, then runs southeast to bottom-right; include flat pebble stepping stones as small gray oval outlines. Waterfall is an abstract band of parallel blue lines at northwest, never a vertical elevation drawing. Three isolated dark outlined low obstacle footprints: irregular flat rock at west-middle, round tree stump southeast of center, another flat rock southwest. Two gold outward arrows on paths at north-center and northeast. Perimeter tree crowns as soft green irregular circular footprint outlines and a few pink crowns. Tiny black dot center for human scale. Clear flat green walkable land on BOTH sides of blue creek. No bridge.

layout_canvas_prompt: WIDESCREEN LANDSCAPE output 16:9 aspect ratio, e.g.1672x941. Reformat this exact existing top-down plan onto a landscape16:9 wide cream paper sheet. Keep the plan's geometry and upright orientation without distortion. Scale the whole existing plan uniformly smaller to occupy the middle 60 percent of image width and about92 percent image height. EXTEND ONLY blank cream paper margins on LEFT and RIGHT, generous margins; do not crop, stretch, rotate, rearrange or redraw geometry. The output must be WIDE LANDSCAPE, not square or portrait. Preserve original zero-perspective top-down view, colors, three obstacles, two gold exit arrows, all water if present. No text, no legend, no other views. Only change canvas to16:9 wide.
creek_v002_prompt: 精准编辑附图（唯一编辑目标），输出相同16:9横向画幅。必须严格保持原图的构图、透视俯视镜头、裁切、整体空间尺度、人物位置和大小、溪流完整走向与宽度、瀑布位置与形状、石头树桩位置以及远处上方的两条分岔小路不变。不增加道路桥梁、建筑、人物或高大障碍物。保持写实3D动作肉鸽游戏概念图质感，真实PBR材质，自然童话森林。只做以下地表与光影编辑：1 左下象限原本较均匀的泥地改成自然不规则镶嵌的苔藓、低矮三叶草、小朵白色与淡紫野花和湿润泥土，都是贴地植被，疏密有层次，保留泥土小片而不是铺满草坪。2 从溪流左侧靠近瀑布下游的岸边，向画面左下角延伸一条弯曲自然、被风吹积的淡粉白樱花花瓣带，花瓣数量明显但彼此可分辨、边缘零散，不能成为粉红地毯，不能覆盖人物周围中央战斗区。3 画外左下方有一棵樱花树，绝对不要画出这棵树的树干或树冠；只将它自然的枝叶树影和大小不一的柔和斑驳暖光投射在左下角地面，令这一区域有光暗节奏。加入一到两缕极淡柔和的斜射晨光进入此区域，不要白色光柱、舞台聚光或浓烟。4 左下画框边缘加入半露的一小块长满厚苔藓的矮石，约0.3米高，大部分在画外，不能挡中央或取代已有的场内矮石。5 整体光影更加唯美但保持自然上午：暖金色阳光、微冷的绿色蓝灰阴影、不同大小柔边光斑。瀑布底部少量水汽被阳光温柔照亮，仍能清楚看到流水和石头；樱花花瓣在逆光下呈现轻薄通透的粉色亮边。不要过曝、不要全局金色滤镜、不要改变天空时间为日落，不要戏剧化打光。中央空地及人物周围保持开阔、地面可读。无文字、无UI、无边框。
